verses.en: Thus saith the Lord your God, even Jesus Christ, the Great I AM, Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end, the same which looked upon the wide expanse of eternity, and all the seraphic hosts of heaven, before the world was made;
verses.sm: Ua faapea ona fetalai mai o le Alii lo outou Atua, o Iesu Keriso lava, o le O A’u Silisili, o le Alefa ma le Omeka, o le amataga ma le gataaga, o ia lava lea na silasila atu i luga o le vavaloloa lautele o le faavavau, ma ’au serafi uma o le lagi, ae lei faia le lalolagi;

verses.en: The same which knoweth all things, for all things are present before mine eyes;
verses.sm: O lea lava e tasi ua silafia mea uma, aua ua i luma o o’u mata mea uma;

verses.en: I am the same which spake, and the world was made, and all things came by me.
verses.sm: O A’u lava lea e tasi o lē na tautala atu, ma faia ai le lalolagi, ma o mea uma na oo mai e ala mai ia te a’u.

verses.en: I am the same which have taken the Zion of Enoch into mine own bosom; and verily, I say, even as many as have believed in my name, for I am Christ, and in mine own name, by the virtue of the blood which I have spilt, have I pleaded before the Father for them.
verses.sm: O A’u lava lea e tasi o lē na avea le Siona a Enoka i lo’u lava loto; ma e moni, Ou te fai atu, o le toatele lava lea o e na talitonu i lo’u igoa, ona o A’u o Keriso, ma o lo’u lava igoa, e ala i le mana o le toto na Ou faamasaaina, na Ou aioi atu ai i luma o le Tamā mo i latou.

verses.en: But behold, the residue of the wicked have I kept in chains of darkness until the judgment of the great day, which shall come at the end of the earth;
verses.sm: Ae faauta, o le toega o e ua amioleaga ua Ou taofia i filifili o le pouliuli seia oo i le faamasinoga o le aso tele, lea o le a oo mai i le iuga o le lalolagi;

verses.en: And even so will I cause the wicked to be kept, that will not hear my voice but harden their hearts, and wo, wo, wo, is their doom.
verses.sm: Ma o le a faapea lava ona Ou faia ia taofia e ua amioleaga, o e e lē fia faalogo i lo’u leo ae faamaaa o latou loto, oi talofa, oi talofa, oi talofa, o lo latou malaia lea.

verses.en: But behold, verily, verily, I say unto you that mine eyes are upon you. I am in your midst and ye cannot see me;
verses.sm: Ae faauta, e moni, e moni, Ou te fai atu ia te outou o ou mata ua i o outou luga. Ua Ou i ai i totonu ia te outou ae ua lē mafai ona outou vaai mai ia te a’u;

verses.en: But the day soon cometh that ye shall see me, and know that I am; for the veil of darkness shall soon be rent, and he that is not purified shall not abide the day.
verses.sm: Ae ua lata ona oo mai o le aso o le a outou vaai mai ai ia te a’u, ma outou iloa ai ua i ai A’u; ona ua lata ona saeluaina o le veli o le pouliuli, ma o ia o lē e lei faamamaina o le a lē gafatiaina le aso.

verses.en: Wherefore, gird up your loins and be prepared. Behold, the kingdom is yours, and the enemy shall not overcome.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, fusi i o outou sulugatiti ma saunia. Faauta, ua a outou le malo, ma o le a lē manumalo le fili.

verses.en: Verily I say unto you, ye are clean, but not all; and there is none else with whom I am well pleased;
verses.sm: E moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ua outou mama, ae lē o outou uma; ma ua leai ni isi tagata o e ua Ou fiafia tele i ai;

verses.en: For all flesh is corrupted before me; and the powers of darkness prevail upon the earth, among the children of men, in the presence of all the hosts of heaven—
verses.sm: Ona ua leaga tagata uma i o’u luma; ma ua sosolo le mana o le pouliuli i luga o le lalolagi, i totonu o le fanauga a tagata, i luma o ’au uma o le lagi—

verses.en: Which causeth silence to reign, and all eternity is pained, and the angels are waiting the great command to reap down the earth, to gather the tares that they may be burned; and, behold, the enemy is combined.
verses.sm: O lea ua mafua ai le nofotupu o le taaligoligoa, ma ua tiga ai le faavavau atoa, ma o loo faatali e agelu le poloaiga tele ia selesele i le lalolagi, e faaputu titania ina ia susunuina; ma, faauta, ua ’au faatasi le fili.

verses.en: And now I show unto you a mystery, a thing which is had in secret chambers, to bring to pass even your destruction in process of time, and ye knew it not;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei Ou te faailoa atu ia te outou se mealilo, o se mea lea o loo faia i totonu o potu faalilolilo, e aumai ai lo outou faafanoga i le āluga o le taimi, ma sa outou lē iloaina;

verses.en: But now I tell it unto you, and ye are blessed, not because of your iniquity, neither your hearts of unbelief; for verily some of you are guilty before me, but I will be merciful unto your weakness.
verses.sm: Ae ua Ou ta’u atu nei ia te outou, ma ua faamanuiaina ai outou, ua lē ona o lo outou amioletonu, po o o outou loto lē talitonu; aua e moni e i ai ni isi o outou ua sala i o’u luma, peitai o le a Ou alofagia lo outou vaivai.

verses.en: Therefore, be ye strong from henceforth; fear not, for the kingdom is yours.
verses.sm: O lea, ia outou faamalolosi mai le taimi nei ma le agai i luma; aua le matatau, aua ua a outou le malo.

verses.en: And for your salvation I give unto you a commandment, for I have heard your prayers, and the poor have complained before me, and the rich have I made, and all flesh is mine, and I am no respecter of persons.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga mo lo outou olataga, aua ua Ou faalogoina a outou talosaga, ma ua tagi mai e ua matitiva i o’u luma, ma o e ua mauoa na Ou faia, ma o tagata uma lava e a a’u ia, ma e lē o A’u o se faailoga tagata.

verses.en: And I have made the earth rich, and behold it is my footstool, wherefore, again I will stand upon it.
verses.sm: Ma ua Ou faia le eleele ia oa, ma faauta o lo’u tuuvae lea, o le mea lea, o le a Ou toe tu ai i ona luga.

verses.en: And I hold forth and deign to give unto you greater riches, even a land of promise, a land flowing with milk and honey, upon which there shall be no curse when the Lord cometh;
verses.sm: Ma Ou te tuu atu ma avatu ia te outou oa e sili atu, se laueleele lava lea o le folafolaga, o se laueleele ua tafe ai le susu ma le meli, lea o le a lē i ai i luga se mala pe a afio mai le Alii;

verses.en: And I will give it unto you for the land of your inheritance, if you seek it with all your hearts.
verses.sm: Ma o le a Ou tuu atu ia te outou e fai ma laueleele o lo outou tofi, pe afai tou te saili i ai ma o outou loto atoa.

verses.en: And this shall be my covenant with you, ye shall have it for the land of your inheritance, and for the inheritance of your children forever, while the earth shall stand, and ye shall possess it again in eternity, no more to pass away.
verses.sm: Ma o la’u feagaiga lenei ma outou, o le a outou mauaina lenei e fai ma laueleele o lo outou tofi, ma mo le tofi o a outou fanau e faavavau, a’o i ai pea le lalolagi, ma o le a outou toe mauaina i le faavavau, e lē toe mavae atu lava.

verses.en: But, verily I say unto you that in time ye shall have no king nor ruler, for I will be your king and watch over you.
verses.sm: Ae, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e oo mai le taimi o le a leai ai so outou tupu po o se pule, ona o le a avea A’u ma o outou tupu ma leoleo i luga o outou.

verses.en: Wherefore, hear my voice and follow me, and you shall be a free people, and ye shall have no laws but my laws when I come, for I am your lawgiver, and what can stay my hand?
verses.sm: O le mea lea, faalogo mai i lo’u leo ma mulimuli mai ia te a’u, ma o le a avea outou ma tagata saoloto, ma o le a leai ni a outou tulafono nao a’u tulafono pe a Ou alu atu, ona o A’u o lo outou faitulafono, ma o se a se mea e mafai ona taofia lo’u lima?

verses.en: But, verily I say unto you, teach one another according to the office wherewith I have appointed you;
verses.sm: Peitai, e moni Ou te fai atu ia te outou, aoao le tasi i le isi e tusa ma le tofi lea na Ou tofia ai outou;

verses.en: And let every man esteem his brother as himself, and practice virtue and holiness before me.
verses.sm: Ma ia taitasi le tagata ma manatu taua i lona uso e pei o ia lava ia te ia, ma fai le amiomama ma mea paia i o’u luma.

verses.en: And again I say unto you, let every man esteem his brother as himself.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, ia taitasi le tagata ma manatu taua i lona uso e pei o ia lava ia te ia.

verses.en: For what man among you having twelve sons, and is no respecter of them, and they serve him obediently, and he saith unto the one: Be thou clothed in robes and sit thou here; and to the other: Be thou clothed in rags and sit thou there—and looketh upon his sons and saith I am just?
verses.sm: Aua o ai se tagata e i totonu o outou ua i ai ni atalii e toasefululua, ma ua lē faailoga tagata ia te i latou, ma ua latou auauna ia te ia ma le usiusitai, ae fai atu o ia i le tasi: Ia e ofu i ofu talaloa ma e nofo i i; ae fai atu i le isi: Ia e ofu i ofu masaesae ma e nofo i ’o—ma vaai atu i ona atalii ma fai mai ua ou amiotonu?

verses.en: Behold, this I have given unto you as a parable, and it is even as I am. I say unto you, be one; and if ye are not one ye are not mine.
verses.sm: Faauta, ua Ou tuu atu ia te outou lenei mea o se faataoto, ma ua faapea lava e pei o A’u. Ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia tasi outou; ma afai tou te lē tasi e lē a a’u outou.

verses.en: And again, I say unto you that the enemy in the secret chambers seeketh your lives.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, ua saili e le fili o loo i potu faalilolilo o outou ola.

verses.en: Ye hear of wars in far countries, and you say that there will soon be great wars in far countries, but ye know not the hearts of men in your own land.
verses.sm: Tou te faalogo i taua i atunuu mamao, ma outou fai ane ua lata ona i ai o taua tetele i atunuu mamao, ae ua outou lē iloa loto o tagata o loo i lo outou lava laueleele.

verses.en: I tell you these things because of your prayers; wherefore, treasure up wisdom in your bosoms, lest the wickedness of men reveal these things unto you by their wickedness, in a manner which shall speak in your ears with a voice louder than that which shall shake the earth; but if ye are prepared ye shall not fear.
verses.sm: Ua Ou ta’u atu ia te outou nei mea ona o a outou talosaga; o le mea lea, ia teu le poto i o outou loto, ne’i faaali atu e le amioleaga o tagata nei mea ia te outou e ala i lo latou amioleaga, i se ala o le a tautala atu ai i o outou taliga i se leo e leotele atu nai lo o lena o le a luluina ai le lalolagi; ae afai ua outou saunia o le a outou lē matata’u lava.

verses.en: And that ye might escape the power of the enemy, and be gathered unto me a righteous people, without spot and blameless—
verses.sm: Ma ina ia mafai ona outou sao mai le mana o le fili, ma faapotopoto mai ia te a’u o se nuu amiotonu, ua aunoa ma se ila ma se pōnā—

verses.en: Wherefore, for this cause I gave unto you the commandment that ye should go to the Ohio; and there I will give unto you my law; and there you shall be endowed with power from on high;
verses.sm: O le mea lea, o le pogai lenei na Ou tuu atu ai ia te outou se poloaiga ia outou o atu i Ohaio; ma o iina o le a Ou tuu atu ai ia te outou la’u tulafono; ma o iina o le a faaeeina ai outou i le mana mai luga;

verses.en: And from thence, whosoever I will shall go forth among all nations, and it shall be told them what they shall do; for I have a great work laid up in store, for Israel shall be saved, and I will lead them whithersoever I will, and no power shall stay my hand.
verses.sm: Ma mai iina, soo se tasi Ou te loto i ai, o le a o atu i totonu o atunuu uma, ma o le a ta’u atu ia te i latou mea latou te faia; ona ua ia te A’u se galuega tele ua teuina, ona o le a laveaia Isaraelu, ma o le a Ou taitaia i latou i soo se mea Ou te loto i ai, ma e leai se mana e taofia lo’u lima.

verses.en: And now, I give unto the church in these parts a commandment, that certain men among them shall be appointed, and they shall be appointed by the voice of the church;
verses.sm: Ma o lenei, Ou te tuu atu i le ekalesia ua i ai i vaega nei se poloaiga, e faapea i ni alii faapitoa o i totonu o i latou o le a tofia, ma o le a tofia i latou i le leo o le ekalesia;

verses.en: And they shall look to the poor and the needy, and administer to their relief that they shall not suffer; and send them forth to the place which I have commanded them;
verses.sm: Ma o le a latou vaaia e ua matitiva ma e ua lē tagolima, ma auauna atu mo lo latou tausiga ina ia latou lē mafatia; ma auina atu i latou i le nofoaga ua Ou poloaiina ai i latou;

verses.en: And this shall be their work, to govern the affairs of the property of this church.
verses.sm: Ma o le latou galuega lenei, e pulea mataupu o meatotino a lenei ekalesia.

verses.en: And they that have farms that cannot be sold, let them be left or rented as seemeth them good.
verses.sm: Ma o i latou ua i ai faatoaga ua lē mafai ona faatau atu, ia tuu pea i latou pe faaaoga-totogi e tusa ma le mea e lelei ia te i latou.

verses.en: See that all things are preserved; and when men are endowed with power from on high and sent forth, all these things shall be gathered unto the bosom of the church.
verses.sm: Vaai ia faasaosaoina mea uma; ma a uma ona faaeeina o tagata i le mana mai luga ma auina atu, o le a faaputuputuina nei mea uma i totonu o le ekalesia.

verses.en: And if ye seek the riches which it is the will of the Father to give unto you, ye shall be the richest of all people, for ye shall have the riches of eternity; and it must needs be that the riches of the earth are mine to give; but beware of pride, lest ye become as the Nephites of old.
verses.sm: Ma afai tou te saili oa ua i ai i le finagalo o le Tamā e tuu atu ia te outou, o le a sili atu ona outou mauoa i tagata uma, aua o le a outou maua oa o le faavavau; ma ua tatau ai ona a a’u oa o le lalolagi e tuu atu; ae ia faaeteete i le faamaualuga, ne’i avea outou e pei o sa Nifaē anamua.

verses.en: And again, I say unto you, I give unto you a commandment, that every man, both elder, priest, teacher, and also member, go to with his might, with the labor of his hands, to prepare and accomplish the things which I have commanded.
verses.sm: Ma Ou te toe fai atu ia te outou, Ou te tuu atu ia te outou se poloaiga, ia o atu tagata taitoatasi, e aofia ai le toeaina, le ositaulaga, le aoao, ma tagata o le ekalesia, ma lona malosi, ma le galue o ona lima, e sauni ma faataunuu mea ua Ou poloaiina ai.

verses.en: And let your preaching be the warning voice, every man to his neighbor, in mildness and in meekness.
verses.sm: Ma ia tuu atu a outou talaiga e avea ma leo o le lapataiga, o tagata taitoatasi i lona tuaoi, i le mālū ma i le agamalu.

verses.en: And go ye out from among the wicked. Save yourselves. Be ye clean that bear the vessels of the Lord. Even so. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma ia outou o ese atu mai totonu o e ua amioleaga. Ia outou laveai outou lava. Ia mama outou o e e tauaaoina ipu a le Alii. E faapea lava. Amene.
